sentences.text: You have a new diagnosis of diabetic ketoacidosis. You have a new diagnosis of type 1 diabetes.

You should stop Metformin 500 mg. You should take Insulin glargine 18 units under the skin once daily at 9 PM. You should take Insulin lispro 1 unit for every 10 g of carbohydrate, plus correction scale per handout with each meal.

If your glucose is below 70 mg/dL, you should take 15 g of fast sugar (4 glucose tablets or 1/2 cup juice) and recheck in 15 minutes. If vomiting will not stop, your glucose is above 300 mg/dL twice in a row with ketones, you are confused, or you have trouble breathing, you should go to the Emergency Department.
You are instructed to attend a diabetes education class on 10/20/2026 and an endocrinology clinic with [CLINICIAN_1] on 10/28/2026.
You should check your glucose levels at least 4 times a day. You should eat a balanced diet and avoid skipping meals. You should stay hydrated and get regular exercise.

items.text: Tienes un nuevo diagnóstico de ketoacidosis diabética. Tienes un nuevo diagnóstico de diabetes tipo 1.

Deberás dejar de tomar Metformin 500 mg. Deberás tomar Insulin glargine 18 unidades bajo la piel una vez al día a las 9 PM. Deberás tomar Insulin lispro 1 unidad por cada 10 g de carbohidrato, más el ajuste según el manifiesto con cada comida.

Si tu glucosa es menor a 70 mg/dL, deberás tomar 15 g de azúcar rápido (4 tabletas de glucosa o 1/2 taza de jugo) y recheckar en 15 minutos. Si el vómito no para, tu glucosa es mayor a 300 mg/dL dos veces seguidas con ketones, estás confundido, o tienes dificultad para respirar, deberás ir al Servicio de Urgencias.
Te has instruido a asistir a una clase de educación sobre diabetes el 10/20/2026 y a una consulta con el endocrinólogo [CLINICIAN_1] el 10/28/2026.

Deberás chequear tus niveles de glucosa al menos cuatro veces al día. Deberás comer una dieta equilibrada y evitar pasar por alto las comidas. Deberás mantener hidratado y hacer ejercicio regularmente.
You have a new diagnosis of diabetic ketoacidosis. You have a new diagnosis of type 1 diabetes.

You will have to stop taking Metformin 500 mg. You will have to take Insulin glargine 18 units under the skin once a day at 9 PM. You will have to take Insulin lispro 1 unit for every 10 g of carbohydrate, plus the adjustment according to the manifest with each meal.

If your glucose is less than 70 mg/dL, you will have to take 15 g of fast sugar (4 tablets of glucose or 1/2 cup of juice) and recheck in 15 minutes. If the vomiting does not stop, your glucose is greater than 300 mg/dL twice consecutively with ketones, you are confused, or you have difficulty breathing, you will have to go to the Emergency Service.
You have been instructed to attend a diabetes education class on 10/20/2026 and a consultation with the endocrinologist [CLINICIAN_1] on 10/28/2026.
You will have to check your glucose levels at least four times a day. You will have to eat a balanced diet and avoid missing meals. You will have to stay hydrated and exercise regularly.
